other_failure_modes.name: In-sample Target Encoding Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies target encoding directly to the training data using the same data's target values, rather than using an out-of-fold (K-fold) strategy. This causes target leakage into the features and can lead to severe overfitting on the training set.

summary: The agent correctly splits the data and applies extensive feature engineering without leaking test data. However, it introduces significant target leakage by mapping target encodings onto the training data directly without an out-of-fold strategy. The evaluation relies on a single run of a stochastic model using only one metric.
